s959.name: Ultra Mega Polyurethane Gun Foam S959
s959.features: Ultra mega polyurethane gun foam, large volume, used for filling, sealing and installing materials. Multi-purpose foam relies on air moisture for full curing. It is recommended to spray water on the foam and application area before, during and after use.
s959.usageAreas: Used for filling cracks, gaps, voids, holes, and fixing door frames, windows and similar partitions. Provides heat and cold insulation in electrical installations and hot/cold water pipes. After the foam dries within 1-3 hours, it can be shaped, cut and painted. Used for bonding all kinds of building materials except silicone, teflon, polyurethane and polypropylene. Resistant to all kinds of weather conditions, seawater, steam and moisture. Not easily flammable.
s959.howToUse: Shake the can vigorously for 30 seconds. Attach the can to the foam gun. Remove dirt, dust and grease from the application surface and spray water on it (spraying water on the application area and foam accelerates foam curing and yields larger volume). During use, turn the can upside down. For reusing the can in subsequent applications, dry foam residue must be removed from the gun and can nozzle. It is preferable to clean foam residue from the can using polyurethane foam cleaner. Because the foam is expandable, precise amounts of foam should be applied to the desired area.

s960.name: Fast Curing Polyurethane Gun Foam S960
s960.features: High performance fast curing polyurethane foam, thanks to its special and advanced formula it provides faster work. It features excellent adhesion power on all types of materials. It can be cut 10 minutes after application and reaches full curing in one and a half hours.
s960.usageAreas: Used for repairing and fixing doors, window frames and similar partitions, insulating electrical installations and hot/cold water pipes, and sealing gaps, holes and cracks. Can adhere to all types of building materials except silicone, teflon, polyethylene and polypropylene.
s960.howToUse: Clean the application area from dirt, oils and dust and spray it with water. Shake the can vigorously for up to 30 seconds. Insert the tube into the gun and turn the can upside down. Let the foam out by pressing the gun trigger. Adjust the foam output rate and volume using the valve at the back of the gun. To reuse the can in subsequent applications, dry foam residue must be removed from the gun and can nozzle. It is preferable to clean foam residue from the can using polyurethane foam cleaner. Because the foam expands and expands, precise amounts of foam should be used on the desired area.

s940.name: Insulation Spray Polyurethane Gun Foam S940
s940.features: Spray polyurethane insulation foam, highly effective thermal and acoustic insulation properties. It has excellent adhesion power to all types of materials.
s940.usageAreas: Used for insulating walls, doors, pipes, ceilings, attics, floors, tanks, etc. Easily and efficiently applied using its special valve. When applied at a thickness of 2 cm, one can provides up to 2 square meters of insulation.
s940.howToUse: Shake the can vigorously for 30 seconds. Turn the can upside down and attach the gun to the can. Place the special application nozzle for each can on the tip of the gun. Adjust the nozzle to reach the application position. The application area must be cleaned of dirt, dust and grease and the surface must be moistened before application. Spray from a distance of 30-40 cm. The speed and amount of foam can be adjusted using the screw at the back of the gun. If desired, additional layers can be applied 30 minutes after the first layer. The width and thickness of the foam can be adjusted by changing the distance between the gun and the desired surface. Any foam residue on the gun and surface must be cleaned using polyurethane foam cleaner.

tech.value: 2 cm width - 2 square meters / 1.5 cm width - 3 square meters

s919.name: Brick & Gas Concrete Adhesive Gun Foam S919
s919.features: Adhesive foam for brick and gas concrete. Specially developed to be an alternative to traditional methods and to bond a variety of solid and hollow bricks, blocks, granite, marble, roofing tiles, natural stone, rocks and other building products. This foam is ideal for building retaining walls, partition walls, gypsum boards, plywood, sills, outbuildings and a wide range of other structures made of bricks or blocks.
s919.usageAreas: Cures within 15-25 minutes. Bonds to all types of building materials except silicone, teflon, polyethylene and polypropylene. It is resistant to all types of weather, seawater, hard water, dilute acids, steam and moisture.
s919.howToUse: Shake the can vigorously for 30 seconds. Attach the foam gun to the can. Remove dirt, dust and grease from the application area and moisten it with water. During use, turn the can upside down and press the gun trigger. Apply the adhesive foam along the horizontal and vertical sections to be bonded. Place the brick or concrete immediately on top of the other brick or concrete. Remove excess foam immediately using polyurethane foam cleaner.

se280.name: Universal Silicone SE280
se280.features: Universal silicone with single main component, flexible, solvent-free, made of 100% silicone. Cures with moisture. Highly adhesive. Unpaintable. Used for bonding parquet and molds. Easy to use, highly adhesive. High quality for home use, does not turn yellow. Shrinkage less than 15% and has an excellent appearance and high transparency.
se280.usageAreas: Has excellent performance in bonding parquet, installing wood, doors, windows, panels, and molds. Also used in fixing wooden furniture, cabinets, wardrobes, stairs, and installing and fixing decorative wood.
se280.howToUse: Make sure the surface on which the silicone is to be applied is dry, clean, and free of dust and grease. Cut the can valve and attach it to the gun. Apply the silicone on the surface in a strip. Clean any silicone residue simply with soap and water.

s220.name: Aquarium Silicone (S220 - S222)
s220.features: A silicone sealant with a single acidic chemical component, characterized by excellent mechanical properties and the ability to bond to many non-porous siliceous materials without the use of a primer. It has a high curing speed in aquariums and industrial applications. It is recommended to cure the product at room temperature to give it permanently flexible silicone properties. Does not yellow. Does not sag. Special high viscosity paste. Easy to attach to the gun. Its surface dries quickly. Shrinks slightly during use. Has good properties when used with a tool. It is flexible at low temperatures (-40 °C) and high temperatures (180 °C).
s220.usageAreas: Used in sealing joints exposed to heavy mechanical loads and in sealing joints that require the generation of rapid mechanical strength. Suitable for building aquariums that meet DIN 32 622 requirements. The adhesive thickness must be at least 1 mm. During use, the temperature must be between 5 °C and 40 °C. It is suitable for use in glazing, industrial applications, and the construction of silos and containers.
s220.howToUse: Make sure the surface on which the silicone is to be applied is dry, clean, and free of dust and grease. Cut the tip of the can and place it in the gun. Apply the silicone on the surface in a strip. Clean any silicone residue simply with soap and water.

tech.label: Colors
tech.value: Transparent S220 | White S221 | Black S222
